intent: Eight original local-history tasks construct a three-stage room timeline, match opposite past/current picture prompts, hold street identity constant while time varies, join benefit and loss, preserve unknown dates and source provenance and support a balanced attitude. Fresh bridge-display transfer changes the setting and rejects invented years and one-sided inference.
picturePurpose: An original fictional room in tool-storage and history-display uses identifies past versus present. Images are illustrations, never historical evidence, exact dates, total photograph counts or proof of benefits/losses.

workshop.title: 排出家乡变化，分清事实与评价
workshop.instruction: 先排时间线，再比较同一地点的变化；有好处也有损失，不知道的年份就保留未知。

items.label: 把房间的变化排成时间线
items.sourceTitle: THREE STAGES OF AN OLD STATION ROOM
items.prompt: Arrange the three uses or states of the room.
items.answer: Tool storage → empty room → history display.
items.reason: At first是最初储藏工具，铁路改线后房间空置；Later才改作历史展室。记录照片来源是展室工作的要求，不是房间用途变化中的一个阶段。
items.hint: At first先给出最初用途；After说明改线后的空置；Later才是后来的展室。
items.material:
THREE STAGES OF AN OLD STATION ROOM
At first, the room beside the old station was used for storing tools.
After the railway route changed, the room stood empty.
Later, with permission, residents turned it into a small history display.
Visitors now compare photographs of the same street taken at different times.
One photograph shows trees that were removed when a road was widened.
Another shows a new path that made walking easier.
The display does not say that every change was an improvement.
Volunteers record where each photograph came from.
They mark uncertain dates as unknown instead of guessing.
A careful local history keeps both useful changes and things people miss in view.

items.label: 一处变化的得与失，都要找出来
items.sourceTitle: THREE STAGES OF AN OLD STATION ROOM
items.prompt: Which two clues show a loss and a benefit?
items.answer: Removed trees are a loss; the easier walking route is a benefit.
items.reason: 道路拓宽时移走了树，是文中保留的损失；新步道让步行更方便，是另一处变化的好处。两者都要考虑，不能只保留对某个结论有利的半边。

transfer.passage:
A SMALL BRIDGE DISPLAY
The photographs show the same river crossing at different times. One shows a new footbridge that made the crossing easier. Another shows the old riverside trees that were lost during the work. The volunteers know where each photograph came from, but the year of one photograph is uncertain. They label that year as unknown. The display asks visitors to consider both the useful change and the loss.
transfer.stem: Which caption would fit this display?

options.text: Every change was an improvement, and an uncertain photograph must be from 1995.
The crossing became easier, some trees were lost, and one photograph has an unknown year.
The lost trees prove that the new footbridge made the crossing harder.

answer.display: The crossing became easier, some trees were lost, and one photograph has an unknown year.

explanation.strategy: 把好处、损失与证据状态分开核对；不能用单方面评价替代事实，也不能替未知年份补一个数字。

steps.text: 新步桥让过河更方便；旧河岸树木在施工中失去。
steps.reason: 原文同时保留好处与损失，不能只读其中一项。

steps.text: 有一张照片年份不确定，标为unknown。
steps.reason: 知道照片的来源，不等于知道每张照片的确切拍摄年份。

distractors.reason: 把所有变化都说成进步，还凭空给未知年份补上1995；两处都越过原文。
树木的损失不能推翻原文明确写出的过河更方便；该项把另一种事实反说了。

explanation.pitfall: 态度题常把部分事实扩大成绝对评价；证据不足时，不能用常识或看起来合理的数字补空白。
